verdicts.reason: A: the black panel shrinks to a small tag around 'MOVIE NIGHT', and all the other white copy (film title, tagline, date, venue, URL) sits straight on the busy black-and-white doodles, so it can't be read and collides with the artwork. B fails the same way: the white copy is scattered over the doodles and unreadable, and the 'MOVIE NIGHT' tag sits at the far right, so the banner doesn't read left to right. A is barely less bad because its headline at least comes first.
